top_signals.title: Why the Pentagon just dropped $450M on tungsten mining
top_signals.summary: The Pentagon recently announced a $450 million investment in The Elmet Group to strengthen the U.S. supply chain for the critical mineral tungsten.

top_signals.title: Former US Air Force members sent to prison over BEC attacks
top_signals.summary: Two former members of the United States Air Force were sentenced to a combined 189 months in federal prison for their roles in a multi-year series of business email compromise (BEC) scams and phishing campaigns. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
